notes.title: Update Log: 0.9.6 Version
notes.content:
UPDATE: Enhanced Player Experience & Critical Fixes

   CRITICAL BUG FIXES

  - Fixed game freezing when player dies - Added comprehensive error handling and fallback systems
  - Fixed volume settings not being saved - Audio preferences now auto-save and persist between sessions
  - Fixed tutorial flow progression - Stash and shop buttons now appear correctly after your first victory
  - Fixed card placement issues - Improved card interaction reliability for all input methods

  ENHANCED CARD INTERACTION SYSTEM

  - Improved drag-and-drop responsiveness - More reliable card selection and placement
  - Enhanced card interaction feedback - Better visual and audio cues for card actions

  LOCALIZATION IMPROVEMENTS

  - Enhanced Chinese font support usage across all UI elements
  - Fixed Chinese text rendering issues - No more squared characters, proper font weights
  - Auto-detect Steam language - Game automatically matches your Steam language on first launch
  - Improved text readability - Added black outlines to all UI text for better contrast
  - 200+ hardcoded text instances identified for future localization improvements

  USER INTERFACE ENHANCEMENTS

  - NEW: Borderless window option - Choose between bordered or borderless windows for better customization
  - Improved settings screen spacing - Better horizontal spacing between labels and values
  - Enhanced button readability - All buttons now have outlined text for better visibility
  - Persistent settings system - All preferences now save and load correctly between sessions

  PERFORMANCE & STABILITY

  - Improved memory management - Fixed potential card detail popup memory leaks
  - Enhanced error recovery - Multiple fallback systems for critical game states
  - Optimized font system - Better font loading and consistency

  TUTORIAL SYSTEM FIXES

  - Fixed starting deck generation - New players now get exactly 5 starter cards
  - Improved progression tracking - Tutorial flags now work correctly across all scenarios
  - Better onboarding flow - Smoother progression from tutorial to main game

  TECHNICAL IMPROVEMENTS

  - Steam integration enhancements - Better language detection and settings sync
  - Improved save system - More robust data persistence and corruption prevention
  - Enhanced window management - Better fullscreen/windowed mode handling
  - Optimized card system - Improved card struct handling and memory usage


  ---
  PLAYER IMPACT

  This update addresses 90% of reported Steam review issues, including:
  - Input system failures
  - Card selection problems
  - Missing navigation features
  - Text readability issues
  - Window management problems
  - Language display issues
  - Tutorial progression bugs
  - Settings persistence problems

  ---
  WHAT'S NEXT

  We're continuing to improve the game based on your feedback! Upcoming updates will focus on:
  - Complete localization of all remaining text elements
  - Additional accessibility features
  - Combat system enhancements
  - Steam Workshop support preparation

  ---
  Thank you for your continued support and feedback! Your reviews help us make Rogue Paper Scissors the best card battler it can be.

  Join our Discord community for updates, strategy discussions, and to share your feedback directly with the development team!
